title: Lock the reports composition
question: The world is settled — the signed-in register in Swiss Minimal Light. Three structures for the Advanced Reports page: a year-scoped, detailed monthly and yearly analysis in MYR. Lock the one to build; use steer for changes.

options.label: The Delta Board
options.thesis: The year read as movement: every headline figure carries its change against last year, and the year-by-year matrix is the second thing on the page.
options.viewport: Page head with the year select; four figure cards whose notes carry signed movement against 2025; below, the year-by-year sheet with the selected year's row tinted blue and the monthly flow chart starting under the fold.
options.risk: Movement reads empty on a first year of data — the delta notes must degrade honestly to "no prior year".

options.label: Money In, Money Out
options.thesis: The year split in half: what came in and what went out as mirrored columns, with what was kept as the strip between them.
options.viewport: Four figure cards, then a kept strip stating the year's net; below it, 'Money in' and 'Money out' as mirrored sheets — each with twelve direction bars and its category shares — beginning the month table under the fold.
options.risk: Two mirrored columns at 1152px squeeze the category rows; each half must earn its width or merge at narrow sizes.

options.label: The Working Register
options.thesis: The dashboard's composition continued for the year: server-rendered figures, the monthly flow chart as the centrepiece, then the twelve-month ledger and the category sheets.
options.viewport: Four figure cards, then the full-width flow chart sheet — income and spend columns under a dashed net line — with the twelve-month ledger beginning under the fold.
options.risk: Closest to the dashboard; the ledger table and category sheets must carry the depth the dashboard never had.
